items.name: Button Control (CustomComponents)
items.criteria: Craft CustomComponents.e modes: mode 0 momentary register-bit set on press and clear on release (FC22 after explicit TCP mapping), mode 1 screen navigation with visibleInWork, and mode 2 constant write (UINT16/Float32).
items.audit_note: Modes 0/1/2 are imported with source metadata and inactive legacy endpoint. Mode 0 requires explicit TCP holding-register remap and opt-in, then FC22 sets/clears on press/release/cancel/pause; native BLOODSKY toggles are preserved. Mode 1 has validated screen picker/URL and preserves visibleInWork. Mode 2 writes FC06/FC16 after remap. Side-by-side UI and hardware acceptance remain open; see docs/BLOODSKY_EXECUTION_STATUS.md.

items.name: Sound / Alarm Trigger (CustomSound)
items.criteria: Craft ID 9 with threshold-driven edge detection, five bundled Craft alarm presets, looping playback while active, stop on clear, and optional user-selected audio file.
items.audit_note: Import preserves posSound 1–5 while disabling legacy device mapping. The editor now exposes all five presets and a custom-file option; Android unit tests/APK pass in Actions #815. Runtime still uses one shared player, so simultaneous active alarm widgets replace one another. Device and visual acceptance remain open.
